calibrate_threshold: calibrate a conformal prediction threshold from validation conformity scores and labels at a given confidence level
predict_threshold: predict confidence sets for test examples by comparing conformity scores against a calibrated threshold
compute_p_values: compute p-values for test examples based on validation conformity scores and labels
predict_p_values: predict confidence sets for test examples using computed p-values and a confidence level
conformal_quantile: compute a corrected quantile for conformal inference from conformity scores and a confidence level
